title: metadata-protocol: a publish build probe that is refused by read admission reports `widget_query_failed` with a fix telling the author to change a dataset that is correct
body:
Filing gate **①**: a measured defect in author-facing text. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024; the lane now reads as `domain:server`) · `os-sales` · session `session_01CxBKycaiUpA1yGx1XyoGqX`, from the `out_of_scope_findings` of #25484's dev report (PR #25533). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:server` seat holding the former engine cards (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts`), one PR, S.

**Priority:** p3 on filing (text only, no behaviour; triage may re-grade).

## What is wrong (measured on PR #25533's head `1bb247c7b6`; the same text is on `origin/main` `build-probes.ts:364`)

After PR #25533, `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts` probes each dashboard widget as the publishing caller. A publisher who cannot read the dataset's object gets an error-tier issue:

- `code: 'widget_query_failed'`, `message: … failed: [Analytics] Access denied: reading <object> is not permitted for this user` (right, and pinned by PR #25533's non-reader case);
- `fix: 'Fix the dataset definition (or the widget's values/dimensions) so the query compiles, then republish.'`

The dataset is correct and compiles. The cause is the publisher's read access. An author who follows the fix edits a working dataset, and an agent reading the report does the same.

**Source:** `build-probes.ts`, the widget plane's `catch (e)` block: one `fix` string for every throw, whatever the error was.

## Shape (for the dev to measure)

Tell a read-admission refusal apart from a query that does not compile, and give it a `fix` that names the real remedy: the publisher (or the role the dashboard is for) needs read access to `<object>`, or the widget is reported for this caller only. Read the distinction from the thrown error's own code or class if the analytics service gives one (⛔ not by matching message text if a code exists). Keep `code` and `severity` unchanged unless the dev measures a reason; the message is already right. Pin both arms (access refusal, compile failure) through the real probe path.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository: "widget_query_failed fix text access denied" → 0 matching. **New.**
